items.title: Injective Says Transfer-Agent Affiliate Is SEC-Registered
items.summary: SEC filings name Injective Institutional Services, LLC; its role concerns official securities ownership records, not approval of the blockchain.

items.title: Grayscale says crypto pullback offers ‘compelling entry points’ as bitcoin falls to $64,000
items.summary: Grayscale Head of Research Zach Pandl said crypto still has strong fundamental demand, such as institutional adoption of stablecoins.

items.title: Bitcoin could slide into the $50,000s as Fed rate hike bets build, Wintermute says
items.summary: Bitcoin may slide into the $50,000s after losing its 200-week average, with ETF outflows, weak demand and rate-hike risks weighing on BTC, leading market maker warns.

items.title: Ex-Robinhood engineer pleads guilty to $125K Hyperliquid trading scheme
items.summary: The former Robinhood engineer used confidential information about upcoming Robinhood token listings to trade on Hyperliquid.
